nce36f17c8e4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the phases of Badami Chalukyan temple architecture?
o: Aihole represents the experimental structural phase
Pattadakal represents the earliest, rock-cut phase
nce36f17c8e4.x: Pattadakal is the mature, final phase; the sequence runs from the rock-cut caves of Badami to the experimental temples of Aihole and then Pattadakal.

na4897fd95bd.s: Which temple at Pattadakal is built in the Nagara style?
na4897fd95bd.x: The Papanatha temple is in the Nagara style; the Virupaksha, Mallikarjuna and Sangameshvara temples are Dravida.

n05612d366a3.s:
Consider the following statements about the end of the Ikshvakus:
1. Rudrapurushadatta was the last Ikshvaku ruler, defeated by the Pallavas.
2. He was defeated by Simhavishnu, founder of the imperial Pallava line.
3. The victory helped establish Pallava rule in the Krishna valley.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n05612d366a3.x: Pallava Simhavarman (not Simhavishnu) defeated the last Ikshvaku ruler Rudrapurushadatta, helping establish Pallava rule in the Krishna valley.

n7614c765f97.s: Which of the following heritage sites was created by the Pallavas?
n7614c765f97.x: Mahabalipuram, with its open-air reliefs, rathas and structural temple, is the Pallava site; Ajanta is a cliff complex of cave paintings and monasteries, not Pallava.

new.s: The Navabrahma temples at Alampur are built in which style?
new.x: The nine Navabrahma temples are Nagara with rekha shikharas, not Dravida.

new.s: In which present-day district are the Alampur Navabrahma temples located?
new.x: Alampur lies in Jogulamba Gadwal district of Telangana, on the Tungabhadra.

new.s: How many temples make up the Navabrahma group at Alampur?
new.x: The Navabrahma group has nine early Badami Chalukya Shiva temples.

new.s: The Vesara style of temple architecture is mainly associated with which region?
o: North India, north of the Vindhyas
South India, between the Krishna and the Kaveri
The Deccan, between the Vindhyas and the Krishna
new.x: Vesara is the Deccan style of the region between the Vindhyas and the Krishna.

new.s: The defining feature of the Dravida temple style is:
o: A flat slab roof without a tower
new.x: Dravida temples are marked by a pyramidal vimana and gopurams; the curvilinear shikhara marks Nagara.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Vesara style:
1. It is a hybrid of the Nagara and Dravida styles.
2. It uses a Dravida plan with Nagara details.
3. It is mainly found north of the Vindhyas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Vesara is a Nagara-Dravida hybrid with a Dravida plan and Nagara details; it belongs to the Deccan, not north of the Vindhyas.

new.s: Which Jain temple at Aihole is built in the Dravida style and bears the Aihole inscription?
new.x: The Meguti Jain temple at Aihole is Dravida and bears the Aihole inscription.

new.s: Which of the following temple – style pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: The Kashi Vishwanatha temple at Pattadakal is Nagara, not Dravida; the other pairs are correct.

new.s: Ravana Phadi at Aihole is best described as:
o: A Nagara temple on an apsidal plan
A rock-cut cave with no tower
A Nagara temple with a rekha shikhara
new.x: Ravana Phadi is a rock-cut cave without a tower.

new.s: The Lad Khan temple at Aihole has which kind of roof?
o: A flat slab roof with no shikhara
A rekha shikhara on an apsidal plan
new.x: Lad Khan is rectangular with a flat slab roof and no shikhara.

new.s: In which year was Pattadakal inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
new.x: Pattadakal became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

new.s: Which Badami Chalukya site was the royal coronation site?
new.x: Pattadakal served as the royal coronation site of the Badami Chalukyas.

new.s: How many main cave temples are there at Badami?
new.x: Badami has four main sandstone caves around Agastya lake; Caves 1-3 are Hindu and Cave 4 is Jain.

new.s: Which Badami cave is the largest and bears Mangalesha's inscription of 578 CE?
new.x: Cave 3, dedicated to Vishnu, is the largest and carries Mangalesha's inscription of 578 CE.

new.s: The 18-armed Nataraja is found in which Badami cave?
new.x: Cave 1 is dedicated to Shiva and has the 18-armed Nataraja; Cave 4 is Jain.

new.s: The capital of the Pallavas was:
new.x: The Pallavas ruled Tondaimandalam from Kanchipuram; Vatapi was the Chalukya capital.

new.s: The Hirahadagalli plates, recording the Agnishtoma, Vajapeya and Ashvamedha sacrifices, belong to:
new.x: The Prakrit Hirahadagalli plates are of Sivaskandavarman, who performed these sacrifices.

new.s: The Renati Chodas were early feudatories of the:
new.x: The Renati Chodas were early Pallava feudatories.

new.s: Which Pallava ruler, founder of the imperial line, defeated the Kalabhras?
new.x: Simhavishnu (c. 575-600) founded the imperial line and defeated the Kalabhras.

new.s: Which of the following titles did NOT belong to Mahendravarman I?
new.x: Vatapikonda (conqueror of Vatapi) was the title of Narasimhavarman I; the others were Mahendravarman I's.

new.s: Which general of Narasimhavarman I sacked Vatapi in 642 CE?
new.x: General Paranjoti sacked Vatapi after Pulakesin II was killed at Manimangala.

new.s: Nandivarman II, an ardent Vaishnavite, was a contemporary of:
new.x: Nandivarman II was a contemporary of Tirumangai Alvar; Appar is linked to Mahendravarman I.

new.s: Bharavi, author of the Kiratarjuniya, adorned the court of:
new.x: Bharavi was at Simhavishnu's court.

new.s: The Dashakumaracharita and Kavyadarsha were written by:
new.x: Dandin of the Pallava court wrote the Dashakumaracharita and Kavyadarsha.

new.s: Which writer of the Pallava court called Vengi 'Andhra Nagaram'?
new.x: Dandin called Vengi 'Andhra Nagaram'.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Mayurasharman:
1. He was a Brahmin student at the Kanchi Ghatika.
2. After being insulted by a Pallava horseman, he founded the Chalukya kingdom.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Mayurasharman studied at the Kanchi Ghatika; after the insult he founded the Kadamba kingdom, not the Chalukya kingdom.

new.s: Hiuen Tsang visited Kanchi around 640 CE during the reign of:
new.x: Hiuen Tsang visited Kanchi c. 640 CE, in the reign of Narasimhavarman I.

new.s: Around which year did the Pallava dynasty end with the killing of Aparajita?
new.x: Aditya I Chola killed Aparajita c. 897 CE, ending the Pallava dynasty.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT one of the later Pallava rulers?
new.x: Simhavishnu was the founder of the imperial line (c. 575-600); Dantivarman, Nandivarman III and Nripatunga were later Pallavas.

new.s: Which phase of Pallava architecture produced the first structural temples?
new.x: The Rajasimha phase (Narasimhavarman II) built the first structural temples such as the Shore Temple.

new.s: The Mandagapattu cave temple was dedicated to:
new.x: Mahendravarman I's Mandagapattu inscription records a temple for Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

new.s: Which material is NOT named in the Mandagapattu inscription's claim of a temple built 'without' it?
new.x: The claim names four materials - brick, timber, metal and mortar; the temple itself is cut in rock.

new.s: The first dvarapalakas at a temple entrance in South India appear at:
new.x: Mandagapattu shows the first dvarapalakas, later common in South Indian temples.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Pancha Rathas at Mahabalipuram?
o: Each was built of brick and timber
new.x: Each ratha is a monolith carved from one granite rock, only copying wooden forms.

new.s: The Shore Temple is the only survivor of the group known as the:
new.x: The Shore Temple survives from the 'Seven Pagodas'; the other six are believed lost to the sea.

new.s: The Kailasanatha temple at Kanchi is built of:
new.x: The Kailasanatha is a sandstone temple; the Mahabalipuram rathas are granite.

new.s: Which Pallava temple has a storeyed sanctum and panels on Pallava history?
new.x: The Vaikuntha Perumal temple of Nandivarman II, a Vishnu temple, has a storeyed sanctum and Pallava history panels.

new.s: The Kailasanatha temple at Kanchi carries a Kannada inscription of:
new.x: Vikramaditya II's Kannada inscription is found in the Kailasanatha temple.

new.s: In which year was Ajanta inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List?
new.x: Ajanta was inscribed in 1983, a year before Mahabalipuram (1984); 1819 is when it was found.

new.s: The Ajanta cave complex consists of:
new.x: Ajanta has 25 viharas and 4 chaityas with Jataka paintings.

new.s: The Panamalai painting of Parvati belongs to which Pallava period?
new.x: The Parvati painting in the Talagirishvara temple, Panamalai, is of the Rajasimha period.

new.s: An inscription at Sittannavasal records a ninth-century renovation by the:
new.x: Sittannavasal was once linked to Mahendravarman I, but an inscription records a 9th-century Pandya renovation.

new.s: The Mogalrajapuram caves, with Shiva and Vishnu shrines, are located in:
new.x: The Vishnukundin Mogalrajapuram caves are in Vijayawada.
